sites.meaning: SPMI channel execute routine returns success without touching the arbiter
sites.evidence: Reached from the single caller at RVA 0x2940; its ldr w9, [x3, x4] at RVA 0x37F0 is the faulting ELR

meaning: SPMI still initialises and installs its protocols; the channel execute routine that builds the arbiter address read by the ldr at RVA 0x37F0 now returns success without touching the bus
evidence: v16 line: ESR 0x96000010 (EC 0x25, DFSC 0x10 synchronous external abort), FAR 0x000000000C777008 = arbiter 0x0C500000 + channel 0x277 << 12 + 8, ELR 0x00000000D1F317F0 = SPMI.efi base 0x000D1F2E000 + RVA 0x37F0
limitations: Every SPMI transfer routed through this routine now reports success without touching the arbiter: PMIC register reads hand back whatever the caller's buffer already held and writes are dropped, so the PMIC minimal-init sequence completes without real hardware I/O and battery/charger status must not be trusted. Driver registration and every other SPMI entry point stay stock. Flip this site to a small error status (e.g. mov w0, #3) if a later build needs the transfer to fail loudly instead.
